summary_text: In July 2026, the user purchased Amul Taaza Pasteurised Toned Milk (500 ml) on one weekend date (2026-07-04) during the evening. This timing aligns with the population baseline for evening purchases (30.27%), which is comparable to the morning baseline (32.46%) and higher than afternoon (25.26%) or night (12.02%). The product is a small-format, single-use liquid milk pack, typically used for immediate consumption such as tea, coffee, or breakfast preparation. As this is a single observation from one date, it is not yet established whether this represents a stable preference for the Amul brand, a specific preference for evening shopping, or a routine purchase pattern. No other brands or dayparts have been observed to determine dominance or habit.
